## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue. Please also include relevant motivation and context. List any dependencies that are required for this change.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change
Please mark options that are relevant:
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update (changes to README, guides, etc.)
- [ ] Code refactoring (improving structure without changing behaviour)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (PEP 8, formatted with Black/Ruff).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have added/modified unit tests or verified changes locally using scratch scripts.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or lint errors.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (e.g. README or SUPPORTED_FORMATS.md) if adding support for a new format.
